title.zh-CN: 左上腹痛与脾大 · 74岁男性
title.en: Left upper abdominal pain and an enlarged spleen · 74-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 74岁男性因左上腹痛就诊，既往发现脾大，并有肺部肿瘤病史。通过问诊、检验、影像与骨髓证据完成诊断推理，在治疗前核查安全事项，并在治疗后分期复评。基于已发表病例的历史资料回看；缺失资料保持未知。
summary.en: A 74-year-old man presents with left upper abdominal pain; an enlarged spleen has been noted before and he has a history of lung cancer. Work through the history, laboratory, imaging and bone marrow evidence to a diagnosis, check safety before treatment, and re-evaluate after treatment phase by phase. A review of historical records from a published case; missing data stay unknown.

provenance.citation: 丁凤丽，秦彩霞，汪家吉. 伴t(4;12)(q23;q13)易位合并肺腺癌的脾边缘区淋巴瘤1例. 中国临床案例成果数据库, 2026.

notes.zh-CN: 病例：丁凤丽、秦彩霞、汪家吉，2026。DOI：10.3760/cma.cmcr20260128-00421。由 Virtual Patient V4（临床方块世界 CASE 01）移植。7张PNG原图与原病例PDF来自用户提供的V4压缩包，原图版权归原权利人；仅在本机安装（clinicalcraft import-v4），不随仓库分发。问诊回答依原文整理。缺失数据保持未知；报告按原始时间呈现。肺癌进展在正文既往史与讨论中的叙述不一致，复盘保留此限制。原CT配图为腹部，没有肺结节局部原图；没有原始流式散点图，也没有完整DICOM序列。人体图谱为标准人体模型，未重建本例病灶大小、肺结节或骨髓浸润范围。患者是使用化名的通用教学NPC，不还原真实患者容貌。V5在V4基础上补充的病史条目与复评期体格检查均摘自原文并逐条注明来源；原文体格检查记录于第3周期治疗入院时，诊断期体格检查未记录。完成度不是已验证的临床能力评分。
notes.en: Case: Ding Fengli, Qin Caixia, Wang Jiaji, 2026. DOI: 10.3760/cma.cmcr20260128-00421. Ported from Virtual Patient V4 (Clinical Craft CASE 01). The seven original PNG figures and the source PDF come from the V4 package supplied by the user; figure copyright remains with the original rights holders. They are installed locally only (clinicalcraft import-v4) and are not distributed with the repository. Interview answers are compiled from the source text. Missing data stay unknown; reports are presented with their original dates. The main text's past history and discussion are inconsistent about lung cancer progression, and the review keeps this limitation. The original CT figures show the abdomen only — there is no local image of the lung nodule, no raw flow cytometry plot and no complete DICOM series. The anatomy atlas is a standard human model and does not reconstruct this patient's lesion size, lung nodule or extent of marrow infiltration. The patient is a generic teaching NPC with a pseudonym and does not reproduce a real patient's appearance. History items and the re-evaluation-phase physical examination that V5 adds to V4 are taken from the source text, each with its source noted; the source's physical examination was recorded on admission for treatment cycle 3, and no diagnostic-phase examination is recorded. Completion is not a validated clinical competency score.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 教学模拟：依据已发表病例报告整理，仅供医学教育使用，不构成诊疗建议。
disclaimer.en: Teaching simulation compiled from a published case report, for medical education only; it is not medical advice.

triageNote.zh-CN: 74岁男性，左上腹痛；脾脏增大。病史待询问。
triageNote.en: 74-year-old man with left upper abdominal pain; enlarged spleen. History still to be taken.

personality.zh-CN: 性格平和、配合的老年男性，耐心回答问题，按病历如实陈述；不清楚或病历没有记录的事情会直接说明，不猜测。
personality.en: A calm, cooperative older man who answers patiently and sticks to what his records say; when something is unclear or not recorded he says so plainly rather than guessing.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 用朴实的普通话口语，句子简短；常转述病历上的记录（如“病例记录……”）；不使用专业推理，不解释检查结果。
speechStyle.en: Plain, everyday speech in short sentences; often relays what his records say ("my notes say…"); does not reason like a clinician or interpret test results.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生您好。我这次主要是左上腹疼，来复查一下。
openingLine.en: Hello, doctor. I've come back for a check-up — it's mainly a pain in the upper left side of my belly.

fallbackUnknown.zh-CN: 这个我的病例里没有记录，我说不上来。
fallbackUnknown.en: That isn't recorded in my case notes, so I can't really say.

actingNotes.zh-CN: 只讲已揭示的病史事实，用自己的话转述，不增减数字、日期或药名。不谈检查结果、体格检查发现或诊断结论。职业、吸烟、饮酒、家族史、疼痛评分和每次疼痛持续时间原病例均未记录，被问到时直接说明没有记录。
actingNotes.en: Only state history facts that have been revealed, in your own words, without adding or changing numbers, dates or drug names. Do not discuss test results, examination findings or diagnostic conclusions. Occupation, smoking, alcohol, family history, pain score and the duration of each bout of pain are not recorded in the source; if asked, say plainly that they are not recorded.

question.en: What treatment have you had since the diagnosis?

answer.zh-CN: 刚确诊时我没同意治疗，签字出院了。后来从2025年4月26日开始先用VP方案（长春新碱加泼尼松）预处理，5月和6月又各做了1个周期利妥昔单抗，过程还算顺利，脾大和血象都比以前好一些。
answer.en: When I was first diagnosed I declined treatment and signed myself out. Then from 26 April 2025 I had pre-treatment with the VP regimen (vincristine plus prednisone), followed by one cycle of rituximab in May and another in June. It went fairly smoothly, and my enlarged spleen and blood counts improved.

answer.en: Since the treatment the tips of my hands and feet have felt numb. The doctors think it's a nerve-toxicity reaction to the VP regimen; it eased slightly with nerve-supporting treatment.

text.en: First presentation: WBC 3.2×10⁹/L, neutrophils 1.3×10⁹/L, Hb 97 g/L, platelets 71×10⁹/L. 2025-04-28: WBC 1.98×10⁹/L, neutrophils 1.05×10⁹/L, Hb 79.10 g/L, platelets 27×10⁹/L.

text.zh-CN: 原文记录“血常规基本恢复”，未提供完整复查数值；不生成数值。
text.en: The source records only that the “blood count largely recovered”; complete repeat values are not provided, and no values are generated.

text.zh-CN: 脾大伴低密度灶，原报告提出“梗死？”；副脾，脾周少量积液，肝门部及腹膜后部分淋巴结增大。原包仅提供增强CT代表层面，不含完整DICOM序列；平扫申请不能视为与增强CT完全等价。
text.en: Splenomegaly with low-density lesions — the original report queries “infarction?”; accessory spleen, a small perisplenic effusion, and enlargement of some lymph nodes at the porta hepatis and in the retroperitoneum. The source package only provides representative contrast-enhanced CT slices, not the full DICOM series; a request for a non-contrast scan cannot be treated as fully equivalent to contrast-enhanced CT.

text.zh-CN: 增大脾脏较前缩小，脾脏多发低密度灶伴边缘强化；肝门部及腹膜后部分淋巴结缩小；副脾及脾周积液较前减少。
text.en: The enlarged spleen is smaller than before, with multiple low-density splenic lesions showing rim enhancement; some lymph nodes at the porta hepatis and in the retroperitoneum are smaller; the accessory spleen and the perisplenic effusion are reduced compared with before.

text.zh-CN: 正文记录左肺上叶结节；2025年6月肺腺癌病灶较前增大，随后调整阿美替尼剂量。原报告讨论部分另称“未见进展”，存在叙述不一致。
text.en: The main text records a nodule in the left upper lobe; in June 2025 the lung adenocarcinoma lesion had grown, after which the aumolertinib dose was adjusted. The discussion section of the original report separately states “no progression” — the narrative is inconsistent.

note.zh-CN: 原包CT配图为腹部代表层面，没有可用于肺结节局部评价的胸部原图。
note.en: The CT figures in the source package are representative abdominal slices; there is no chest image usable for local evaluation of the lung nodule.

text.zh-CN: 正文记录左肺上叶结节；双侧肺门及纵隔部分淋巴结较前略缩小。未提供肺结节直径。
text.en: The main text records a nodule in the left upper lobe; some bilateral hilar and mediastinal lymph nodes are slightly smaller than before. The lung nodule diameter is not provided.

note.zh-CN: 原包CT配图为腹部代表层面，没有可用于肺结节局部评价的胸部原图。
note.en: The CT figures in the source package are representative abdominal slices; there is no chest image usable for local evaluation of the lung nodule.

text.zh-CN: 脾大，脾静脉增宽；脾门等回声，考虑副脾。图2标注脾纵向距离9.90 cm、横向距离17.45 cm。保留原图测量名称，不用二维数字推算体积。
text.en: Splenomegaly with a widened splenic vein; an isoechoic structure at the splenic hilum, considered an accessory spleen. Fig. 2 labels the splenic longitudinal distance 9.90 cm and transverse distance 17.45 cm. The original measurement names are kept, and volume is not estimated from two-dimensional measurements.

text.zh-CN: 脾大，脾静脉增宽，脾脏片状低回声。图7标注脾纵向距离5.53 cm、横向距离13.40 cm。
text.en: Splenomegaly with a widened splenic vein and patchy hypoechoic areas in the spleen. Fig. 7 labels the splenic longitudinal distance 5.53 cm and transverse distance 13.40 cm.

text.zh-CN: 双侧锁骨上淋巴结：左9×7 mm、右7×8 mm；颈部最大12×5 mm，腋窝最大13×6 mm，腹股沟最大17×6 mm。
text.en: Bilateral supraclavicular lymph nodes: left 9×7 mm, right 7×8 mm; largest cervical 12×5 mm, largest axillary 13×6 mm, largest inguinal 17×6 mm.

note.zh-CN: 没有浅表淋巴结超声原图；脾脏超声图不能替代。
note.en: There are no original images of the superficial lymph node ultrasound; the splenic ultrasound images cannot substitute for them.

text.zh-CN: 双侧锁骨上淋巴结：左6×4 mm、右7×4 mm；颈部最大12×6 mm，腋窝最大11×6 mm，腹股沟最大15×7 mm。
text.en: Bilateral supraclavicular lymph nodes: left 6×4 mm, right 7×4 mm; largest cervical 12×6 mm, largest axillary 11×6 mm, largest inguinal 15×7 mm.

note.zh-CN: 没有浅表淋巴结超声原图；脾脏超声图不能替代。
note.en: There are no original images of the superficial lymph node ultrasound; the splenic ultrasound images cannot substitute for them.

text.zh-CN: 全身PET/CT：脾脏明显肿大、代谢异常增高；建议进一步排除淋巴瘤。代谢增高本身不等于病理确诊。
text.en: Whole-body PET/CT: markedly enlarged spleen with abnormally increased metabolism; further work-up to exclude lymphoma was recommended. Increased metabolism by itself is not a pathological diagnosis.

note.zh-CN: 原始图中保留了来源标记；仅在本地教学材料中使用。
note.en: The original figure retains its source markings; for use in local teaching material only.

text.zh-CN: 全身PET/CT：脾脏明显肿大、代谢异常增高；建议进一步排除淋巴瘤。代谢增高本身不等于病理确诊。
text.en: Whole-body PET/CT: markedly enlarged spleen with abnormally increased metabolism; further work-up to exclude lymphoma was recommended. Increased metabolism by itself is not a pathological diagnosis.

note.zh-CN: 仅有治疗前PET/CT，未提供治疗后PET复查。
note.en: Only the pre-treatment PET/CT exists; no post-treatment PET was provided.

text.zh-CN: 三系增生活跃，淋巴瘤样细胞占2%。骨髓穿刺细胞学与骨髓组织活检是不同取材方法；需要活检与免疫组化时另行申请相应检查。
text.en: All three lineages are actively proliferating; lymphoma-like cells 2%. Bone marrow aspirate cytology and bone marrow tissue biopsy are different sampling methods; when a biopsy and immunohistochemistry are needed, order those investigations separately.

text.zh-CN: 三系增生活跃。原文转归概述骨髓细胞学及流式结果转阴，但没有复查骨髓细胞图片。
text.en: All three lineages are actively proliferating. The source's outcome summary states that bone marrow cytology and flow cytometry turned negative, but no repeat marrow cytology images are provided.

text.zh-CN: 骨髓活检：低级别小B细胞淋巴瘤，肿瘤细胞约15%，MF-1级，倾向边缘区淋巴瘤。CD19、CD20、PAX5及IgD阳性；CD5、CD10、Cyclin-D1、SOX11、LEF1、CD103、Annexin-A1阴性；Ki-67＜5%。图5未逐一标明A/B切片抗体名称，不擅自补注。
text.en: Bone marrow biopsy: low-grade small B-cell lymphoma, tumour cells about 15%, marrow fibrosis grade MF-1, favouring marginal zone lymphoma. CD19, CD20, PAX5 and IgD positive; CD5, CD10, Cyclin-D1, SOX11, LEF1, CD103 and Annexin-A1 negative; Ki-67 <5%. Fig. 5 does not label the antibody for each of panels A/B, and no labels are added here.

text.zh-CN: 骨髓活检：低级别小B细胞淋巴瘤，肿瘤细胞约15%，MF-1级，倾向边缘区淋巴瘤。CD19、CD20、PAX5及IgD阳性；CD5、CD10、Cyclin-D1、SOX11、LEF1、CD103、Annexin-A1阴性；Ki-67＜5%。图5未逐一标明A/B切片抗体名称，不擅自补注。
text.en: Bone marrow biopsy: low-grade small B-cell lymphoma, tumour cells about 15%, marrow fibrosis grade MF-1, favouring marginal zone lymphoma. CD19, CD20, PAX5 and IgD positive; CD5, CD10, Cyclin-D1, SOX11, LEF1, CD103 and Annexin-A1 negative; Ki-67 <5%. Fig. 5 does not label the antibody for each of panels A/B, and no labels are added here.

text.zh-CN: 检出约1.58%的CD5阴性、CD10阴性成熟单克隆B淋巴细胞；未见明显急性白血病及高危MDS相关免疫表型异常证据。与活检15%并非同一分母，不能直接比较。

text.zh-CN: 46,XY,t(4;12)(q23;q13)。分析20个中期分裂相，均见一条4号与一条12号染色体长臂相互易位。核型不能确定融合基因，也不能证明与肺癌同源。

text.zh-CN: 肺腺癌转移可以解释全部异常

feedback.zh-CN: 骨髓有独立的成熟B细胞肿瘤证据，不能把脾大和三系减少直接归因于肺癌转移。
feedback.en: The marrow shows independent evidence of a mature B-cell neoplasm; the splenomegaly and trilineage cytopenia cannot simply be attributed to metastatic lung cancer.

text.zh-CN: SMZL伴骨髓侵犯，与肺腺癌并存
text.en: SMZL with bone marrow involvement, coexisting with lung adenocarcinoma

feedback.zh-CN: 符合原病例诊断。脾脏主导表现与低级别B细胞证据共同支持SMZL；肺癌需建立独立病理及分子证据链。
feedback.en: Consistent with the source case diagnosis. The spleen-dominant presentation together with the low-grade B-cell evidence supports SMZL; the lung cancer needs its own, separate pathological and molecular evidence chain.

text.zh-CN: 单纯感染性脾大，无需考虑肿瘤

feedback.zh-CN: 感染可能影响病程，但不能解释本例骨髓单克隆B细胞及组织病理证据。
feedback.en: Infection may affect the course, but it cannot explain this patient's monoclonal B cells in the marrow or the histopathological evidence.

prompt.zh-CN: 开始抗CD20治疗前，哪项认识更合适？

need.zh-CN: 先开具并阅读乙肝筛查／HBV DNA记录。

text.zh-CN: 补全HBsAg等信息，制定再激活预防与监测方案

feedback.en: The material does not provide HBsAg. HBV status should be fully assessed, and a prophylaxis and monitoring plan made in light of the anti-CD20 therapy.

feedback.en: A bone marrow karyotype alone is not enough to prove that the lung cancer and the lymphoma share a common origin, nor can a fusion gene be determined directly from the breakpoints.

text.zh-CN: 是本例核型发现，共同机制仍需配对组织验证

feedback.zh-CN: 正确保留证据边界：同源性及驱动机制需要两种肿瘤的配对分子证据。
feedback.en: This correctly keeps the evidence boundary: common origin and driver mechanisms require paired molecular evidence from both tumours.

prompt.zh-CN: 治疗后的资料最合理支持什么结论？

need.zh-CN: 切换到复评期，阅读腹部CT或超声，以及复查流式。

feedback.zh-CN: 流式改善只覆盖相应血液学证据，不能替代肺癌复评，也不能单独判定淋巴瘤完全缓解。
feedback.en: Improvement on flow cytometry only covers the corresponding haematological evidence; it cannot replace re-evaluation of the lung cancer, nor can it on its own establish complete remission of the lymphoma.

text.zh-CN: 淋巴瘤有治疗反应，两种肿瘤仍需分别复评

text.zh-CN: 带教提示不超过2次

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 学员用患者能理解的话解释为何需要血常规、影像及骨髓检查；避免堆砌术语；确认患者理解并留出提问机会；在证据充分前不向患者下诊断结论。
judgeGuidance.en: The learner explains in words the patient can follow why blood tests, imaging and bone marrow tests are needed; avoids piling up jargon; checks understanding and invites questions; and does not give the patient a diagnosis before the evidence supports it.

text.zh-CN: 坦诚说明病例中缺失或未知的信息，不臆测、不诱导
text.en: Is open about information that is missing or unknown in the record, without guessing or leading the patient

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 当患者无法回答（如吸烟史、家族史、EGFR位点、肺癌TNM、HBsAg）时，学员承认信息缺失，不施压、不替患者补造事实，并说明将如何获取这些信息。
judgeGuidance.en: When the patient cannot answer (e.g. smoking, family history, EGFR variant, lung cancer TNM stage, HBsAg), the learner acknowledges the gap, neither pressures the patient nor supplies invented facts, and says how the information would be obtained.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只依据学员已调阅的报告文字与原包代表图解读，不补充报告以外的发现。原包只有代表层面截图，没有完整DICOM序列：不能重建图像或测量体积，不用二维测量值推算脾脏体积；不同时间点的代表图未经配准。原包仅有增强CT代表图，平扫与增强CT不能视为等价。胸部CT和浅表淋巴结超声只有文字记录，没有原图；肺结节直径未提供；原文关于肺癌是否进展的叙述前后不一致。PET/CT代谢增高本身不等于病理确诊，且只有治疗前PET/CT。不对病理、分期或最终诊断下结论。
knowledge.en: Interprets only the report text and the representative images in the source package that the learner has already retrieved, and adds no findings beyond the reports. The package contains only representative slices, not full DICOM series: no reconstruction or volume measurement is possible, and spleen volume must not be estimated from two-dimensional measurements; images from different time points are not co-registered. Only contrast-enhanced CT images exist, so a non-contrast CT is not equivalent. The chest CT and the superficial lymph node ultrasound exist only as text, with no images; the lung nodule diameter is not given; the source is internally inconsistent about whether the lung cancer progressed. Increased metabolism on PET/CT is not by itself a pathological diagnosis, and only a pre-treatment PET/CT exists. Does not draw conclusions about pathology, staging or the final diagnosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只依据学员已调阅的骨髓细胞学、骨髓活检／免疫组化、流式细胞术、染色体核型及EGFR检测记录解读，不补充报告以外的抗体或结果。骨髓穿刺细胞学与骨髓活检是不同取材方法；细胞学、流式与活检的比例分母不同，不能直接比较；不能仅凭CD5、CD10阴性单独定性，需结合形态与完整免疫表型。图5未逐一标明A/B切片的抗体名称，不擅自补注。核型不能确定融合基因，也不能证明与肺癌同源；同源性及驱动机制需要两种肿瘤的配对分子证据。没有原始流式散点图、治疗后活检图或复查核型。EGFR具体位点、检测平台和原始报告未提供，不补写19del或L858R。
knowledge.en: Interprets only the bone marrow cytology, bone marrow biopsy / immunohistochemistry, flow cytometry, karyotype and EGFR testing record that the learner has already retrieved, and adds no antibodies or results beyond the reports. Marrow aspirate cytology and marrow biopsy are different sampling methods; the percentages from cytology, flow cytometry and biopsy have different denominators and cannot be compared directly; CD5/CD10 negativity alone cannot characterise the disease — morphology and the full immunophenotype must be considered. Fig. 5 does not label the antibody for each of panels A/B, and none should be added. A karyotype cannot identify a fusion gene or prove a common origin with the lung cancer; common origin and driver mechanisms require paired molecular evidence from both tumours. There are no raw flow cytometry plots, no post-treatment biopsy images and no repeat karyotype. The specific EGFR variant, testing platform and original report are not provided; 19del or L858R must not be filled in.

knowledge.zh-CN: 以苏格拉底式提问带教，不直接给出诊断或判断题答案。引导顺序：问诊（疼痛、脾大病程、既往肿瘤）→ 血常规与腹部影像 → 骨髓活检与流式 → 会诊板提交诊断推理 → 乙肝筛查、染色体核型与治疗后复评。当学员把所有异常归因于单一疾病时，追问哪些证据支持、哪些证据不支持。提醒：缺失资料保持未知，不补造；结果按原始日期呈现；切换病例时期是历史资料回看，不推进患者实时病情；不同取材方法的比例不能直接比较；约30年前就发现脾大，不能据此认定淋巴瘤已经持续30年；完成度与判断记录是教学脚本指标，不是经过验证的能力评分。
knowledge.en: Teaches by Socratic questioning and never gives the diagnosis or the answers to the decisions directly. Suggested path: history (pain, course of the splenomegaly, previous tumours) → blood count and abdominal imaging → bone marrow biopsy and flow cytometry → submit the diagnostic reasoning at the board → hepatitis B screen, karyotype and post-treatment re-evaluation. When the learner attributes every abnormality to a single disease, ask which evidence supports that and which does not. Reminders: missing data stay unknown and are never invented; results keep their original dates; switching case phase is a review of historical records, not live progression; percentages from different sampling methods cannot be compared directly; a spleen known to be enlarged for about 30 years does not by itself establish that a lymphoma has been present for 30 years; completion and decision records are teaching-script measures, not a validated competency score.

title.zh-CN: 病例完成 · 两种肿瘤，两条证据链
title.en: Case complete · Two tumours, two evidence chains

conclusion.zh-CN: SMZL伴骨髓侵犯，与EGFR突变阳性左上肺浸润性腺癌并存。
conclusion.en: SMZL with bone marrow involvement, coexisting with EGFR-mutation-positive invasive adenocarcinoma of the left upper lung.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 脾脏主导表现与低级别B细胞证据结合判断；不能把所有异常归因于肺癌，也不能以CD5/CD10阴性单独定性。
keyReasoning.en: Judge the spleen-dominant presentation together with the low-grade B-cell evidence; do not attribute every abnormality to the lung cancer, and do not characterise the disease on CD5/CD10 negativity alone.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 原文鉴别诊断：套细胞淋巴瘤表达CD5、Cyclin D1，滤泡性淋巴瘤表达CD10、Bcl-6。本例CD5、CD10、Cyclin-D1、SOX11阴性，结合形态与完整免疫表型，不支持这两种诊断。
keyReasoning.en: Differential diagnosis in the source: mantle cell lymphoma expresses CD5 and cyclin D1, and follicular lymphoma expresses CD10 and BCL6. Here CD5, CD10, cyclin D1 and SOX11 are negative; taken together with the morphology and the full immunophenotype, this does not support either diagnosis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 原文讨论指出：脾脏组织病理是SMZL诊断的金标准，但受手术及穿刺风险限制；SMZL常伴骨髓侵犯，骨髓活检证实特征性窦内淋巴细胞浸润且免疫表型相符时可支持诊断，仍需与脾弥漫性红髓小B细胞淋巴瘤等鉴别。
keyReasoning.en: The source's discussion notes that splenic histology is the gold standard for diagnosing SMZL but is limited by the risks of surgery and needle biopsy; SMZL often involves the bone marrow, and a marrow biopsy showing the characteristic intrasinusoidal lymphocytic infiltration with a matching immunophenotype can support the diagnosis, although splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma and similar entities still have to be distinguished.

boundaries.zh-CN: 脾脏与流式改善支持治疗反应。PR为原作者报告；现有数据不足以独立完成标准化复核。两种肿瘤分别评价。
boundaries.en: Improvement in the spleen and on flow cytometry supports a treatment response. PR is as reported by the original authors; the available data are insufficient for an independent standardised re-assessment. The two tumours are evaluated separately.

unknowns.en: Mechanism of any common origin of the two tumours

teachingPoints.zh-CN: HBcAb阳性且将接受抗CD20治疗时，不能仅凭HBV DNA低于检测限排除再激活风险。
teachingPoints.en: When HBcAb is positive and anti-CD20 therapy is planned, an HBV DNA below the detection limit cannot by itself rule out the risk of reactivation.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 仅有骨髓核型不足以证明肺癌与淋巴瘤同源，也不能据断点直接确定融合基因。
teachingPoints.en: A bone marrow karyotype alone is not enough to prove that the lung cancer and the lymphoma share a common origin, nor can a fusion gene be determined directly from the breakpoints.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 流式改善只覆盖相应血液学证据，不能替代肺癌复评，也不能单独判定淋巴瘤完全缓解。
teachingPoints.en: Improvement on flow cytometry only covers the corresponding haematological evidence; it cannot replace re-evaluation of the lung cancer, nor can it on its own establish complete remission of the lymphoma.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 骨髓穿刺细胞学与骨髓组织活检是不同取材方法；流式比例与活检比例并非同一分母，不能直接比较。
teachingPoints.en: Bone marrow aspirate cytology and bone marrow tissue biopsy are different sampling methods; flow cytometry and biopsy percentages do not share a denominator and cannot be compared directly.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 肺癌进展在正文既往史与讨论中的叙述不一致，复盘保留此限制。
teachingPoints.en: The main text's past history and its discussion are inconsistent about lung cancer progression; the review keeps this limitation.
